clauses.title: Grounds of Complaint
clauses.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 9
clauses.text: 9. Grounds of Complaint Any customer aggrieved by an act or omission of a Bank resulting in deficiency in service may file a complaint under the Scheme personally or through an authorised representative as defined under clause 3(1)(c).
clauses.query: grounds of complaint act or omission of bank resulting in deficiency in service

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 3(1)
clauses.text: (i) “Deficiency in service” means a shortcoming or an inadequacy in any service, which the Bank is required to provide statutorily or otherwise, which may or may not result in financial loss or damage to the customer; (j) “Non-Banking Financial Company” (NBFC) means an NBFC as defined in Section 45-I (f) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and registered with the Reserve Bank, to the extent included under the Scheme but does not include, an NBFC in resolution or winding up/liquidation, or under Directions of Reserve Bank of India; (k) “Non- bank Prepaid Payment Instruments Issuer” means a company, as defined in the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013), which has been granted a Certificate of Authorisation by the Reserve Bank of India under Section 7(1) of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007) to operate as a Prepaid Payment Instrument Issuer; (l) “RBI Deputy Ombudsman” means a person appointed by the Reserve Bank as such under Clause 4 of the Scheme; (m) “RBI Ombudsman” means a person appointed by the Reserve Bank as such under Clause 4 of the Scheme; (n) “Regulated Entity” means a bank or a Non-Banking Financial Company, or a Non - bank Prepaid Payment Instruments Issuer or a Credit Information Company as defined in the Scheme, or any other entity as may be specified by the Reserve Bank from time to time, to the extent not excluded under the Scheme; This is Public document. (o) “Rejected Complaints” means complaints that are closed under the provisions as specified in clause 16 of the Scheme. (p) “Settlement” means an outcome of the processes under clause 14 of the Scheme; (q) “The Reserve Bank” means Reserve Bank of India constituted under Section 3 of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

draft: I am writing to formally report an unauthorized UPI transaction of ₹18,500 debited from my Bank of India account. While I initially mentioned the incident occurred around 11 PM, I have verified the exact details as 4 October 2026, at 12:30 PM, with Transaction ID 9836728. I did not authorize this payment, nor did I share any OTP or credentials with anyone, despite receiving a suspicious call prior to the incident. Upon discovering the deduction, I immediately contacted the bank to block my UPI/account and filed a formal complaint with the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal. This unauthorized debit constitutes a deficiency in service [C1]. Under [C2], I expect the bank to maintain the security of my account. I request you to investigate this fraudulent transaction immediately and initiate the recovery of my funds. Please provide a status update on my complaint [TRANSACTION / COMPLAINT REFERENCE] by 8 November 2026. If this matter is not resolved within 30 days, I will be compelled to escalate this grievance to the RBI Ombudsman under the Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026.

## If there's no reply
**Reply due by 8 November 2026** — if the bank does not reply within 30 days of receiving your complaint, you can go to the RBI Ombudsman (Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 10(1)).

1. **Bank grievance cell → Principal Nodal Officer** (email / bank complaint portal — cgro.boi@bankofindia.bank.in) — First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint number; escalate to the Principal Nodal Officer if unresolved.
   📅 reply due by 8 November 2026
2. **RBI Ombudsman (RB-IOS, 2026)** (RBI CMS portal / email) — No reply within 30 days, or the reply is unsatisfactory. Also crpc@rbi.org.in. No fee. https://cms.rbi.org.in · 14448 (RBI contact centre)
   📅 you can go here from 8 November 2026 if unresolved
3. **District Consumer Commission** (online filing (e-Jagriti)) — Deficiency in banking service is also a consumer dispute. https://e-jagriti.gov.in
   📅 you can go here from 8 November 2026 if unresolved

_Information, not legal advice._
